findings.title: Link step misses a dangling .claude/skills symlink
findings.detail:
`[ -e ".claude/skills/$name" ] || ln -s ...`: `-e` is false for a dangling symlink, so `ln -s` then fails with 'File exists'. Only happens if a link exists without its folder, which the copy just recreated, so practically unreachable.
Axis: standards
Suggestion: Use `[ -e … ] || [ -L … ] || ln -s …`, or `ln -sfn`.
